items.title: Giants Ridge Ridge Mountain Bike Trail Map
items.html:
Discover Northern Minnesota’s Premier Mountain Biking Destination

Welcome to Giants Ridge Bike Park, where rugged terrain, scenic views, and thrilling trails converge to offer one of the most diverse biking experiences in the Midwest. Whether you're a beginner, a gravity-fueled adventurer, or a cross-country explorer, there's a trail waiting for you here. Follow our “Pre-Ride, Re-Ride, Free-Ride” safety model to get the most out of your day.

Full Trail Map → https://www.giantsridge.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/2022-Mountain-Bike-Map-FINAL.pdf

TRAIL CATEGORIES

Gravity Freeride (Orange)

For riders seeking jumps, flow lines, and heart-pumping descents. Accessed via the lift.

  • Ribbit One, Two, Three – 0.28 mi each | Intro trails with berms and smooth rolls.

  • Tadpole – 0.28 mi | Short but fun and fast.

  • Leapfrog – 0.66 mi | Great transitions and moderate features.

  • Featherlys – 0.74 mi | Smooth and flowy, ideal for intermediate riders.

  • Return to Sender – 0.6 mi | Connects to multiple routes.

  • Sector 12 – 0.6 mi | Big features and progressive lines.

  • Goliath – 0.74 mi | Advanced freeride challenge.

Gravity Technical (Green, Black, Red)

Steep, rocky, and rooty—perfect for technical riders.

  • Kitty Cat – 1.0 mi (Green Circle) | Mellow intro to gravity trails.

  • Techonite – 0.45 mi (Black Diamond) | Rock features & tighter turns.

  • Granite Gorge – 0.41 mi (Double Black Diamond) | Big drops and serious challenge.

CROSS-COUNTRY TRAILS

Enchanted Flowest Area (Green to Black)

Gentle gradients to challenging forest routes.

  • Enchanted Flowest Access – 0.65 mi | Entry to the XC trail network.

  • Turtle Trot – 0.81 mi | Ideal for beginners.

  • Moonshiner – 1.6 mi | Flow with a few technical surprises.

  • Ridge Runner – 1.6 mi | Winding through pines with scenic views.

  • Fine Whine – 1.0 mi | Technical XC trail.

  • Ore Not – 0.64 mi | Black diamond level effort required.

South Trails (Blue to Black)

  • Bootcamp – 0.51 mi | Perfect warm-up.

  • Norway – 1.4 mi | Gentle curves, fun pace.

  • Miners Mile – 1.0 mi | Fast-paced, intermediate XC ride.

  • Boulder Project – 0.14 mi | Short, techy section to test your skills.

LITTLE GIANTS SKILLS PARK

Practice your skills before hitting the mountain! The Skills Park is perfect for beginners and families, with progressive features designed to build rider confidence and technique.

Whether you're visiting for the first time or a seasoned Giants Ridge rider, this park offers the perfect blend of adrenaline, natural beauty, and trail variety. Pick your line, drop in, and enjoy the ride!

items.title: Giants Ridge Winter Trail Map
items.html:
Explore Giants Ridge with ease using the interactive trail map below. It showcases 35 alpine ski trails served by five chairlifts and two conveyor lifts, plus summer hiking and biking routes.

Trail & Ski Map: https://www.giantsridge.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/2024-Alpine-Map-FInal-scaled.jpg

items.title: Skiing & Snowboarding
items.html:
Hit the slopes at Giants Ridge for an unforgettable winter adventure. With well-groomed runs for all skill levels, top-quality ski and snowboard rentals, and affordable daily tickets and season passes, it’s the perfect spot for beginners and seasoned pros alike.

Everything you need for a great day on the mountain is right here.

More info: https://www.giantsridge.com/skiing-snowboarding/

items.title: Nordic Skiing
items.html:
Giants Ridge is a premier Nordic skiing destination with a rich history—its trail system once served as a training ground for the U.S. Ski Team. Today, skiers of all ages and skill levels can explore miles of scenic trails through the Superior National Forest, with options ranging from green to black.

Whether you're out for a peaceful glide or a serious workout, you’ll find the perfect trail here.

More info: https://www.giantsridge.com/cross-country-skiing/

items.title: Snow Tubing
items.html:
Snow tubing is a must-try winter activity that's fun for all ages—no experience needed! Glide down one of three tubing lanes, then ride the tow lift back up for more. It’s an easy, exciting way to enjoy the snow with family and friends.

More info: https://www.giantsridge.com/snow-tubing/

items.title: Snowshoeing
items.html:
Explore the quiet beauty of winter on over 3.6 miles of scenic snowshoe trails. Wander through peaceful Northwoods landscapes along the Northface, Lower & Upper Sleeping Giant, and Narrows Trails—some even wrapping around Wynne Lake.

A great way to enjoy the outdoors at a slower pace, surrounded by the natural beauty of the Superior National Forest.

More info: https://www.giantsridge.com/snowshoeing/

items.title: Fat Tire Biking
items.html:
Giants Ridge is a pioneer in Minnesota’s fat tire biking scene. Ride over 60 kilometers of groomed Nordic trails or take on the thrill of downhill fat biking on select gravity-fed trails like Tadpole, Ribbits, Leapfrog, and Kitty Cat.

With routes winding through the scenic Superior National Forest, this is winter biking at its best.

More info: https://www.giantsridge.com/fat-tire-biking/
